notes: This contract records provider- and FOM-independent API checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 RTI runtime identity. The C++ test checks the standard rtiName and rtiVersion functions; the Java test checks the corresponding standard RtiFactory methods. Both require non-empty values stable within one process while intentionally leaving provider-specific identity strings unconstrained.

api_surfaces.signature: rtiName and rtiVersion runtime identity functions

api_surfaces.source: adapter-supplied official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java API JAR
